$comment: What the RecordType extension of the guidelines adds to the schema of the guidelines: the RecordType, the format of data that a part of the system outputs and keeps in its store (s-7vm323mhry2enx3), written as a JSON Schema 2020-12 object.

schema.$comment: A RecordType is a rule of the section that declares it (s-ktfstpv8rurznrp), and is numbered among its rules; its title is the RecordType's name and its text what the RecordType is for (s-6eb92ddch7shuvu). The implementation's types and runtime checks are generated from it and never written beside it (s-e877bnfa559tvk9). A RecordType that refines another RecordType node is a variant of it where it carries answersTo (s-z3dnru6qqdf9m6j).

The format itself, as a JSON Schema 2020-12 object: each field a property, with its type, its bounds, whether its value is guaranteed (required) and what it means (description). The fields of the RecordType's variants are added to a data record as an if/then pair adds them in JSON Schema.

chosenBy.$comment: On a RecordType some of whose fields' values decide which other fields a data record holds: those fields, its own or inherited, which select its variant (s-z3dnru6qqdf9m6j).

answersTo.$comment: On a RecordType variant: the value it corresponds to of each field selecting the variant, its keys exactly the fields the nearest RecordType up its chain of refines names as selecting it (s-z3dnru6qqdf9m6j).

identifiedBy.$comment: Where another RecordType refers to this one by an identifier: the field, its own or inherited, that identifies its data records, whose type an identifier of it takes (s-6eb92ddch7shuvu).

fieldName.$comment: A field's name as the code spells it: an identifier in camelCase, so the generated types use it as it stands.

recordFormat.$comment: What the RecordType extension requires of every schema within a RecordType's schema, at any depth: a field's values come from one source only (s-xfu2gpzddjnmgks). Its own list is the field's enum, each value in it once. The names of the parts of the base specification (s-gqavjzcmubg5pvk) and the sids of the nodes of one kind (s-mt6auv3jz8m5gzh) are named by x-enumSource, which also holds the values gathered for the field (s-ju5vcanbjph7mgh). A field never has both.

enumSource.$comment: Where a field's values come from when they are not its own list, and the values gathered from there. from parts: the names of the parts into which the base specification is divided, read from the specification (s-gqavjzcmubg5pvk). from kind: the sids of the nodes of the project's own kind that kind names and that are in the base specification (s-mt6auv3jz8m5gzh). gathered: each value with the sid of the node it comes from, gathered anew by the SpecSheriff tools after every change to the specification and written by them alone (s-ju5vcanbjph7mgh). The types and runtime checks generated from the RecordType take the gathered values as the field's enum.
